drive.drives_per_application_today_source: Module 155 sessions never survive prepare -> approve (per-process RUNTIME Map); the approve drain re-drives every posting from scratch. Session reuse scenario uses 1.
drive.seconds_per_drive_source: Throughput lane solo doorstep drives on the production assembly (Gusto Greenhouse form, gauntlet profile): 163.3 / 157.4 / 170.7 s; mean 163.8, rounded to 164. Doorstep only — the live submit leg is NOT_RUN, so a completed application's final submit seconds are not in this number.

host.concurrency_source: MEASURED: the board service is one process with a synchronous handle() — during a drive an authenticated no-op probe hit p99/max 27.9 s vs 23-39 ms idle. One serial drive lane per host until K-parallel board processes land (O5 M3).
host.label: ESTIMATE
host.source: Assumption for one always-on worker host of this VM's class (2 vCPU / 8 GB). Anchors (public pages checked 2026-10-21): Hetzner CX33-class 4 vCPU / 8 GB at EUR 8.49/mo + EUR 0.50 IPv4 (EU); DigitalOcean 4 vCPU / 8 GB at $48/mo. $30/mo sits between the EU and US anchors. The current worker runs on the Muse VM itself ($0 incremental today); $30 is the planning price for a dedicated host.

non_drive_compute.label: MEASURED
non_drive_compute.source: Throughput lane test-world full cycle: prepare drain 5.6-5.8 s per 50 (feed-dominated) + approve drain 17-25 ms; bench-50 in-process run 2026-10-21 measured 0.65 s of leg 1-3 CPU on synthetic data. 6 s is the conservative (live-shelf) figure; per-application = 6/50 = 0.12 s.

not_counted.chat_turns: NOT_COUNTED per application — conversation model spend is metered per chat turn in production (model_calls.ts reserve/record), shared across every task a turn serves; attributing turns to applications needs the metering hook (metering-hook-spec-2026-10-21.md).
not_counted.egress: NOT_COUNTED — the egress proxy/relay is unmetered today; per-drive page traffic has never been measured. Hetzner-class plans include 20 TB; revisit if a meter ever shows it matters.
not_counted.supabase: NOT_COUNTED — flat project plan, no per-application metering exists; the apply path's RPC/row writes are not priced per call on the current plan.

note: Every input carries a label: MEASURED (a lane ran it), ESTIMATE (derived/assumed, range given), NOT_COUNTED (excluded by design, reason in the doc). refresh-cost-model.cjs recomputes the whole model from this file — replace an input when a better measurement lands and re-run.

provisioned_view.label: ESTIMATE
provisioned_view.source: Scenario only: drives cluster in waking/recruiting hours, so a serial lane is not packed 24/7. The provisioned view divides the drive leg by this efficiency (x4 at 0.25). It is a planning scenario, not a measurement.

tokens.composition_source: Code audit of the full apply composition (155/149/121/123/132/148 + batch-executor + production-sources): no model-provider endpoint, API key, or model client anywhere in the require graph; tailor (123) is parse/select/assemble with a fact-ID truth audit, screening (121+132) is rules, form answers (149 ANSWER_KEY_SOURCES) are stored fact-bank values, render (148) is a hand-built local pipeline. Dynamic proof: bench-50 full 50-run under a fetch tripwire completed with 0 external fetch attempts, 50 prepared+approved.

essay_draft.drafts_per_application_basis: Scenario assumption for the headline line: one drafted written answer per application. Applications with no written question, or where the user writes their own, carry 0.
essay_draft.input_tokens_basis: ESTIMATE from code constants: payload = question + company + relevant confirmed facts (factText) + fix notes on retry. No live count exists — no paid call was run (budget $0).
essay_draft.label: ESTIMATE
essay_draft.max_calls_source: Code: essay_draft.ts retry loop `for (tries = 1; tries <= 2; tries++)` — one rewrite maximum, through the injected deps.model (line 250).
essay_draft.output_tokens_basis: ESTIMATE bounded by code: answers capped at HARD_CHARS = 2000 chars (~500 tokens); DEFAULT_WORDS = 250 when the form states no limit (~330 tokens).
essay_draft.price_source: Repo's own table: supabase/functions/_shared/model_gateway.ts PRICES (third-party price tables, 2026-10-11; the file itself flags the cost as an estimate until reconciled with the provider bill).
essay_draft.status: WO-line code (essay_draft.ts draftEssay, wired at career_apply_questions.ts:334); NOT on the deployed v248 line — ships with the O5 merge. Fires only when a posting has an open-ended written question AND the user elects a draft; never automatic per application.

tsenta_starter.source: PUBLIC, baseline doc ~/workspace/your_files/competitor-baseline-2026-10-21.md (Tsenta pricing + AI disclosure pages, opened 2026-10-21): Starter $19/month, 600 applications per 30-day cycle; Tsenta's own stated per-application cost at Starter: ~$0.03/app.
